title: BL World Icon Editor
description: Customize your Minecraft world icons with in-game screenshots!
body:
# 🖼️ BL World Icon Editor

BL World Icon Editor lets you replace your Minecraft world's icon using an in-game screenshot.

No external editors.
No manually resizing images.
Just load your world, line up the shot, and capture it instantly.

---

## ✨ Features

- Capture world icons directly in-game
- Automatically saves as the correct icon format
- Simple hotkey-based workflow
- Works with singleplayer worlds
- Lightweight and fast

---

## 📸 How To Use

1. Open the world you want to change the icon for
2. Position your camera where you want the thumbnail shot
3. Press `F1` to hide the HUD for a clean screenshot
4. Press the mod hotkey
5. The world icon updates automatically

---

## 🎬 Recommended

For the best-looking thumbnails:

- Use `F1` mode before capturing
- Use shaders if desired
- Set weather/time with commands
- Try cinematic angles

---

## ⚠️ Notes

- The mod edits the world's `icon.png`
- Existing world icons will be replaced
- Singleplayer only

---
